{"metadata":{"description":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that allows you to change the reasoning effort of custom models in WebUI.","id":"gh:1333462669","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-effort-tweak","slug":"Toukaiteio/dsh-effort-tweak","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that allows you to change the reasoning effort of custom models in WebUI."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Effort Tweak"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"DSH Effort Tweak adds a small settings page for the per-model capabilities of each model in a DeepSe"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ek Harness custom provider: input types, context window, maximum output, and the reasoning levels th"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"e endpoint accepts. It is designed for the case where the model capability must be edited in `llm-pi"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"-ai` configuration but the official Web UI does not yet expose that control."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Adds **Settings → Model capabilities** to the DSH Web UI.
- Lists models explicitly configured in "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"`llm-pi-ai.providers.<provider>.models`.
- Edits four model fields together: `input` (text and/or im"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"age), `contextWindow`, `maxTokens`, and `reasoningEfforts`.
- Lets you choose `off`, `minimal`, `low"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, or `max` for the reasoning levels.
- Accepts typed capacities such as "},{"id":"p6s5","text":"`131072`, `256K`, or `1M`, and leaves a blank field inherited instead of copying the fallback into t"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"he model.
- Shows what a blank field would inherit from the provider's `defaultContextWindow`, `defa"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"ultMaxTokens`, and `defaultInput`.
- Preserves the model's other fields and existing provider-specif"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"ic wire values.
- Saves through DSH's settings service, so no manual configuration-file editing is n"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"e values.
- Saves through DSH's settings service, so no manual configuration-file editing is needed."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The page intentionally does not show catalog-only providers. Add a model list to a custom provider f"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"irst, then open this page to tune that model."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install from a release"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Windows PowerShell"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Run PowerShell as your normal user and execute:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"To install into another Profile without starting Web UI:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### macOS and Linux"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"For another Profile:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The scripts download the latest GitHub Release archive, verify the GitHub-provided SHA-256 digest wh"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"en available, keep it under `DSH_HOME/plugin-archives/dsh-effort-tweak/` for future dependency resol"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"ution, install it with `dsh plugin`, and start the default `web` Profile unless `--no-start` or `-No"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ith `dsh plugin`, and start the default `web` Profile unless `--no-start` or `-NoStart` is supplied."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Install a local package"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Restart DSH Web after installing or updating the plugin so the new client bundle is loaded."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Requirements: Node.js 22.19 or newer and pnpm 10."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The CI workflow checks types, runs unit and bundle integration tests, builds the host and browser bu"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ndles, and uploads the package archive. Pushing a matching tag such as `v0.1.0` runs the release wor"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"kflow and publishes the archive to GitHub Releases."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Configuration shape"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The plugin edits this part of the `llm-pi-ai` namespace:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- `input` declares the request modalities the endpoint accepts. Blank leaves the field out, so the i"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"nstalled catalog entry, then the provider's `defaultInput`, decide; `llm-pi-ai` treats an empty list"},{"id":"p29s3","text":" the same way, so this page never writes one.
- `contextWindow` and `maxTokens` must be positive int"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"egers. Blank removes the field, so the provider's `defaultContextWindow` and `defaultMaxTokens` appl"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"y, and the page shows those values as the inherited hint.
- `reasoningEfforts` decides which effort "},{"id":"p29s6","text":"levels the DSH model picker can offer. The plugin uses the existing value for a level when one is al"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"ready present; a newly enabled level is initialized with its canonical name."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"MIT.
